description:
When she was ten, Wanseo survived after eating the Peach of Immortality of the Queen Mother of the West. For a long time, she has secretly loved Ho, a nine-tailed fox. As Wanseo grows older, the scent of peaches around her becomes stronger, causing her to become a target for yokai. 

While her father goes to meet the Heavenly Emperor about the matter, Ho is assigned to protect her. In the process, Ho’s heart slowly begins to waver, and eventually, a proposal letter arrives from the Heavenly Emperor, ordering her to choose a spouse and enter into an engagement...

[Original Webtoon](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14211287)
